chmt_codec.energy_fields: CHMT_ENERGY_FIELDS in chmt_seed.H: 49 explicit nonzero signed energy/temperature/pressure channels, including chemistry energy residual and ParticleQ energy/mechanical energy.
chmt_codec.independent_fields: CHMT_INDEPENDENT_FIELDS: geometry and time retain precise values; final owner exception list still pending, no blanket mass double assertion.

thresholds.field_import: exact bits of destination member static_cast from original double; no nonexistent FP32 mantissa bits
thresholds.native_roundtrip: exact selected-type values and identical reserialization
thresholds.legacy_particle_temperature: FP32 exactly float(Told + 0.125/(153.5/0.101961276)) for mobile linear branch
thresholds.wire: old and new state.chmt byte length equal; all old writer translation units use historical unmodified Checkpoint.C
thresholds.unknown_metadata: existing read succeeds and values preserved; known precision directions owned by shared planner codec

chmt_codec.physical_fields: CHMT_PHYSICAL_FIELDS: 78 selected-width mass/species/progress/porosity/source-residual/velocity/momentum and particle/contact fields. Every seeded value is checked on legacy import and native roundtrip. Physical residual meaning remains intact.
chmt_codec.particle_fields: Compile-time scalar widths: physical fields selected, global position/contact times double, historical 8/64 enthalpy profile arrays float. Exact selected-value wire checks include ParticleQ mass, energy, diameter, area, velocity/contact-relative velocity, saved velocity, ring masses, position and contact times. Mobile carry import has its separate fixed formula.

thresholds.rule: All expected values and bounds fixed before execution. E=decltype(GasQ.energy), eps=epsilon(E). For FP64 use old_bound; FP32 old_bound + operation_count*eps*participating_scale. Every measurement prints actual/expected/scale/old_bound/new_bound and dimensional unit.
thresholds.thermal: real solveSurfaceInterface and solveDrySurfaceInterface, T strictly between 600 and1000 hot or400 and900 cold, signed conductive heat, both independent Fourier+radiation and returned residual <=4*(absEnergy/(area*dt)+relEnergy*flux_scale)+256*eps*flux_scale; adapter T old1e-7K+64eps*Tscale; dt=0.01s, hot ambient750K/cold700K, radiation required nonzero; transfer magnitude >16eps*max(inventories) and signed gas/solid updates with individual2eps state budgets
thresholds.film: Energy old1e-10 W/m+4eps*abs(H*speed); mass old1e-14 kg/(m s)+4eps*abs(m*speed); both signs
thresholds.radiation: old1e-8 W/m2 +16eps*|power| and required hot/cold sign
thresholds.ledger: 64 gasfilm/solidfilm transactions, all decomposition channels and PV nonzero; total old1e-8J+256eps*(initial inventories + sum abs transfers); mass old1e-12kg; per-gas/solid energy32eps, film128eps state-scale; film expected delta must exceed its allowance; per gas/solid mass64eps state-scale; signed nonzero physical inventory changes required. These prevent gross total budget hiding a no-op.
thresholds.phase_rate: old1e-9W/m2+48eps*|power|; signed cubic residual and direction
thresholds.thermal_mass: old1e-14kg+4eps mass scale; wet total old1e-12kg+128eps mass scale

limitations: Host fixtures exercise actual production headers, not CUDA device execution.
No full mesh motion, dynamic boundary-layer profile, chemistry reaction-network or general wet evaporation root coverage claimed.
Legacy mobile carry is covered; active8/64 profile values are wire width/order checked but active-profile carry import is not numerically covered.
Ordinary algorithmic residuals and geometric sweep remainder remain tested and are not treated as forbidden energy carry.
Final candidate source remains unfrozen; provisional owner closure compilation is not final binary acceptance.
Design revision3 is code/type preparation only. Actual consumed source hashes and host compilation are provisional, not final candidate or numerical evidence.
design_principle: FP32 physical energy, mass, composition and non-geometric film fields are one selected-precision value; no carry/second low word. Only explicitly justified global geometry/tracking/microretreat/time/API-wire exceptions remain double.
